title: Continuous left-inverse field for the derivative of a C¹ immersion
statement: Let P, d ∈ ℕ, V ⊆ ℝ^d open and ψ : ℝ^d → ℝ^P C¹ on V with Dψ(y) injective for every y ∈ V. Then there is a map R : ℝ^d → L(ℝ^P, ℝ^d), continuous on V, with R(y)∘Dψ(y) = id_{ℝ^d} for every y ∈ V.
lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (V : Set (Euclid d)) (ψ : Euclid d → Euclid P), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ V → (∀ y ∈ V, Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ y)) → ∃ R : Euclid d → (Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid d), ContinuousOn R V ∧ ∀ y ∈ V, (R y).comp (fderiv ℝ ψ y) = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid d)
